profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Data & AI Platforms | Hands-On Technical Leadership
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff Software Engineer with 13+ years of experience building and operating data-intensive systems in highly regulated domains, including healthcare, defense, and large-scale cloud platforms.

My role today focuses on hands-on technical leadership across data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI-enabled systems. I design and implement core platform capabilities, review and guide complex changes through production, and help teams make architectural decisions that scale across services and organizations. I stay deeply involved in both design and delivery, particularly where systems are high-impact, ambiguous, or long-lived.

In recent years, I’ve led pragmatic adoption of AI at both the backend and developer-workflow level. This includes building and reviewing LLM-backed processing pipelines, long-running workflows, and data enrichment systems, as well as guiding teams in responsible use of AI coding tools. My approach emphasizes correctness, observability, security, and maintainability over novelty—especially in environments where mistakes are costly.

I care deeply about building technology that matters. Much of my career has centered on health-related systems, where good engineering directly affects real people. I lead and mentor engineers by fostering strong technical standards, cross-functional collaboration, and a culture of thoughtful, evidence-driven decision-making. I prioritize creating environments where engineers can ask hard questions, surface risk early, and challenge design decisions constructively—because that’s how complex systems stay healthy.

I regularly influence technical direction across teams by establishing patterns and guardrails, mentoring senior engineers, and unblocking delivery by diving into the hardest parts of the codebase. While my formal title is Staff Engineer, my current scope includes Principal-level responsibilities, spanning cross-team technical leadership, system design, and long-horizon architectural decisions—while remaining actively engaged in writing and reviewing critical code. 

I’m interested in Staff+ or Principal-level roles where I can combine deep data engineering expertise with responsible AI adoption, particularly in organizations using technology to improve outcomes in healthcare, science, or other high-impact domains.

Specialties: Python, Java, AWS, Azure, Data Engineering, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, AI-Enabled Platforms, Technical Leadership
